project_info.theme: Surreal popcorn puppet at an amusement park
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, denim blue, caramel yellow, popcorn gold, red and white

main_subject.detail: A surprised young Asian woman in a black camisole, ripped jeans, and gray sneakers is controlled as a marionette by a giant hand above, while an inverted striped popcorn bucket spills over her.
main_subject.style: Photoreal surreal advertising poster, low-angle cinematic action

composition_elements.text: THE PROMPTER INDONESIA; A Big Family That Cares for Other; XMIIIRU_
items: Top: giant fair-skinned hand holding wooden cross-shaped marionette controller.
Center: frightened female puppet with strings on wrists, ankles, and waist.
Mid-left: striped popcorn bucket tipping and scattering caramel popcorn.
Background: sunny amusement park with roller coaster, Ferris wheel, visitors, and blue sky.
Bottom: white footer branding and black credit badge.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Low-angle perspective, dynamic motion, cinematic blue-sky clarity, grounded shadows

prompt_instructions: Do not use a real person likeness without an approved reference.
Keep strings visibly connected to the wooden controller.
Treat footer branding as optional/replaceable unless the user owns it.
